cover_headline: Blackstone's Next $50 Billion in India Will Go Beyond Offices and Malls

end.headline: Blackstone's Next $50 Billion in India Will Go Beyond Offices and Malls
end.line: The firm plans to double India exposure to $100 billion in five years, expanding from real estate into infrastructure, credit, healthcare and data centres.

facts: Blackstone has about $50 billion invested in India and plans to double that to $100 billion over the next five years
Real estate built Blackstone's India position: about $22 billion of property, more than 150 million square feet of office and retail space
Blackstone has opened a global capability centre in Bengaluru — its first outside the United States

quote.speaker: Jonathan Gray
quote.text: In a developed market, you might be buying existing businesses or real estate. Here, you have to be a builder.
